name: Asset Inventory
query:
SELECT
	channel                                  AS "Channel:Data:190",
	SUM(in_flight)                           AS "Unpublished:Int:110",
	SUM(retrying)                            AS "Refetch:Int:90",
	SUM(abandoned)                           AS "Abandoned:Int:100",
	SUM(files)                               AS "Files:Int:90",
	SUM(on_vm)                               AS "OnVM:Int:80",
	ROUND(SUM(bytes) / 1073741824, 2)        AS "Space GB:Float:100"
FROM (
	SELECT
		CONCAT('Telephony·', COALESCE(NULLIF(c.telephony_medium, ''), 'Unknown')) AS channel,
		SUM(m.recording_state = 'Awaiting' AND COALESCE(m.recording_ref_url, '') =  '') AS in_flight,
		SUM(m.recording_state = 'Awaiting' AND COALESCE(m.recording_ref_url, '') <> '') AS retrying,
		SUM(m.recording_state = 'Abandoned')                                           AS abandoned,
		0 AS files, 0 AS on_vm, 0 AS bytes
	FROM `tabCRM Call Media` m
	JOIN `tabCRM Call Log` c ON c.name = m.call
	GROUP BY channel

	UNION ALL

	SELECT
		'WhatsApp',
		SUM(w.custom_media_state = 'Awaiting' AND COALESCE(w.custom_media_ref, '') =  ''),
		SUM(w.custom_media_state = 'Awaiting' AND COALESCE(w.custom_media_ref, '') <> ''),
		SUM(w.custom_media_state = 'Abandoned'),
		0, 0, 0
	FROM `tabWhatsApp Message` w
	WHERE COALESCE(w.custom_media_state, '') <> ''

	UNION ALL

	SELECT
		CASE
			WHEN f.attached_to_doctype = 'CRM Call Log'
				THEN CONCAT('Telephony·', COALESCE(NULLIF(c.telephony_medium, ''), 'Unknown'))
			WHEN COALESCE(f.custom_wa_message_id, '') <> '' THEN 'WhatsApp'
			ELSE CONCAT('Other·', COALESCE(NULLIF(f.attached_to_doctype, ''), 'Unattached'))
		END,
		0, 0, 0,
		COUNT(*),
		SUM(f.custom_uploaded_to_azure = 0),
		SUM(f.file_size)
	FROM `tabFile` f
	LEFT JOIN `tabCRM Call Log` c
		ON f.attached_to_doctype = 'CRM Call Log' AND c.name = f.attached_to_name
	WHERE f.is_folder = 0
	GROUP BY 1
) inventory
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY SUM(bytes) DESC, channel ASC
